text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What, are claw machines your thing<n>or something? I
don't think normal<n>people can get this many.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I would've been able to<n>win any
plushies myself. You're<n>really good at claw
machines, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, sorry, what I mean is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Where should I put them? I should<n>talk to Taiki
about these... Oh, I forgot<n>to say something
important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for getting these for me... I'll<n>keep some at
my parents' house too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for winning these for me...<n>I'll send
some to my parents too!
